hints: Focus on electrons lost and gained, since a redox equation must balance atoms and charge by balancing electrons first.
Notice that each Zn loses 2 electrons to form $\text{Zn}^{2+}$, while one $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$ ion needs 6 electrons to form $2\text{Cr}^{3+}$.
Think how many Zn atoms are needed to supply those 6 electrons, then check that Cr, O, H and total charge all balance.
walkthrough:
**Write the two half-equations**

Great start, let's separate oxidation and reduction. Zinc is oxidised and dichromate is reduced.

Oxidation:
$$\text{Zn} \rightarrow \text{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^-$$

Reduction in acid:
$$\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} + 14\text{H}^+ + 6e^- \rightarrow 2\text{Cr}^{3+} + 7\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Balance the electrons**

Electrons lost must equal electrons gained. One dichromate needs 6 electrons, but each Zn only gives 2.

So we need 3 Zn atoms:
$$3 \times (\text{Zn} \rightarrow \text{Zn}^{2+} + 2e^-)$$

**Combine and check the full equation**

Add the half-equations together and cancel the electrons:
$$\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-} + 3\text{Zn} + 14\text{H}^+ \rightarrow 2\text{Cr}^{3+} + 3\text{Zn}^{2+} + 7\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

Check quickly: Cr 2 = 2, O 7 = 7, H 14 = 14, Zn 3 = 3. Charge left: -2 + 14 = +12. Charge right: 6 + 6 = +12. Fully balanced.

options.A: Not balanced for Zn or charge. Left charge is +12 but right charge is +8, and only 2 electrons are supplied when 6 are needed. This is the trap of forgetting to balance electrons.
options.B: Zn ions are balanced in charge but Zn atoms are not. You cannot have 1 Zn on the left making 3 $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ on the right. This comes from balancing charge without balancing atoms.
options.C: Correctly uses 3 Zn to supply the 6 electrons needed by one $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$. All atoms balance (Cr 2, O 7, H 14, Zn 3) and total charge balances at +12 on each side.
options.D: Has too much dichromate. With $2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$ you would get 4 Cr, 14 O and need 12 electrons, but the rest of the equation is unchanged. This is the trap of changing the Cr species instead of the Zn.
